_provenance.author: Builder (R3 mission)
_provenance.source_concept: synthetic; isolates Hypothesis 2 (single-CTA accent vs frequency weighting)
_provenance.failure_mode_caught: Accent color (#2EC4B6 teal) appears on a single button. A frequency-weighted extractor reports the dominant colors (white background, black text) and drops the accent. Correct output preserves the CTA color.

rubric_expectations.notes: Color slots are NOT in the default-set (#2EC4B6 is a distinctive accent), so the all-default-colors rule does NOT fire; accent has high LAB distance from text. Distinct display/body fonts; no penalty flags expected.
